title: Add append-only container shipment milestone evidence
description: Add an append-only operational milestone register beneath the canonical shipment-reference record from ERP-057. Record user-supplied departure, arrival, inspection and customs-release evidence without polling an external service or treating the entries as authoritative carrier or customs confirmation. Do not auto-advance business documents, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add bounded milestone evidence to an existing ERP-057 shipment record using an explicit allowlist that covers actual departure, actual arrival, inspection and release-related operational events.

Each event records its type, event timestamp, bounded source description, bounded notes, recorder and recorded time; unavailable values remain unknown and are not inferred from planned dates, document status or free text.
The server validates the parent shipment and supported event type and rejects duplicate active evidence with the same parent, type and event timestamp rather than silently merging it.

Incorrect milestone evidence can be voided with a bounded reason while preserving its original type, timestamp, source and audit history; hard deletion and rewriting of voided evidence are not provided.
A recorded inspection or release event is labeled as repository evidence and is not presented as a legally authoritative customs decision, carrier confirmation or permission to ship.
Milestones do not automatically change container booking, pre-loading, loading-list, Sales Order, inventory, Trade Document, invoice, expense, finance, tax or settlement state.
Historical inconsistencies and missing parent references remain inspectable as invalid or unavailable evidence and are never silently reassigned to another shipment.
Legacy shipment records without milestones remain readable, and no request-time or production backfill is performed.
List and history queries are bounded or paged, avoid per-row database access, and repository schema changes are idempotent and validated only through permitted local or test-database paths.

Unit/integration tests cover supported event types, missing optional evidence, duplicate rejection, void history, unavailable parents, legacy records, bounded queries and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open a shipment reference, record actual departure and inspection evidence with explicit source notes, and verify the chronological evidence is visible without advancing any container or order status.

Attempt duplicate milestone evidence, verify rejection, then void an incorrect event and confirm its original values and reason remain visible without being presented as an authoritative customs decision.

human_gate.reason: Append-only repository evidence only. External carrier or customs access, production database execution, operational authorization, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
